blocks.text: You can view additional details of the compliance breaches, such as the list of policies that are noncompliant for a specific compliance framework, failed resources, and policies mapped to compliance frameworks. This allows you to quickly investigate and remediate the issue.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Compliance.
On the Compliance page, click any tile to view the compliance details.
See image.
On the compliance framework page, you can see the following tabs:
Summary
View a high-level overview of the total failed policies by severity and control category. You can see:
The compliance framework details:
Description: The name of the compliance framework.
DLP Engines: The DLP engines mapped to the compliance framework.
Data Stores: The total number of noncompliant data stores.

The number of failed policies by severity (Critical, High, Medium, and Low). Hover over the donut chart to see the number of failed policies for each severity. Click to view the list of policies on the Policies tab with the severity filter preselected.
The number of failed policies for each control category. Click to view the list of policies on the Policies tab with the control category filter preselected.

The failed compliance trend for policies and resources. Hover over the chart to view the number of failed policies and resources for the control category. You can view the data for the last 7, 15, 30, 60, or 90 days.
Policies
View the list of noncompliant policies. For each failed policy, you can see:
Control Number: A unique identifier assigned to a specific policy within a compliance framework.
Data Stores: The number of data stores for which the policy failed. Click to view the noncompliant policies and resources on the Findings tab with the Policy ID preselected.
Resources
View the list of noncompliant resources. For each resource, you can see the name of the noncompliant resource along with its additional details.
Findings

View the list of noncompliant policies along with the corresponding resources for the selected compliance framework. For each policy, you can see the name of the noncompliant resource along with its additional details.
Configuration
View the policies mapped to compliance frameworks. For each policy, you can see:
Policy Name: The name of the policy mapped to the compliance framework.
Control Number: A unique identifier assigned to a specific policy within a compliance framework.
See image.
The following fields are common across the tabs:
Cloud: The name of the cloud service provider.
Cloud Account: The account ID of the cloud account where the resource is stored.
Region: The region where the resource is located.
Policy Name: The name of the failed policy. Click to view the policy details.
DLP Engines: The DLP engines that match the data in the resource.
Resource ID: The unique identifier for the resource.
Control Category: The control category groups security controls addressing similar risks or compliance requirements.
Severity: The severity (Critical, High, Medium, or Low) of policy failure.
On each tab, you can:
Apply filters to view specific data.
Customize and save a page setting.
Search for a specific policy (not applicable for the Summary tab).
Export the data and download the report as an Excel file (not applicable for the Summary tab).
See image.
